pages.title: All Drop Triggers
pages.text: A quick overview of every drag-and-drop trigger in DragIt. Click the category icons to the left for detailed instructions on each feature.

pages.title: Appearance
pages.text: $(bold)Skin$() — Open your inventory, drag a .png file in.$(br)$(note)Limit: 128×128 px max.$()$(br2)$(bold)Cape (static)$() — Open inventory, switch to third-person, drag an image in.$(br2)$(bold)Cape (video)$() — Same as above, drag a video file instead.$(br)$(note)Requires NarutoLoading.$()

pages.title: In-World
pages.text: $(bold)Painting$() — Aim your crosshair at a painting entity, drag an image in.$(br2)$(bold)Item Frame Image$() — Aim at an item frame, drag an image in.$(br)$(note)Adjacent frames facing the same direction are merged into one large image.$()$(br2)$(bold)Item Frame Video Screen$() — Aim at an item frame, drag a video in.$(br)$(note)Requires NarutoLoading.$()

pages.title: Other
pages.text: $(bold)Chat Image$() — Open chat ($(key)T$() key), drag one or more images in.$(br2)$(bold)Loading Screen Video$() — While on the main menu (no world loaded), drag a video in.$(br)$(note)Requires NarutoLoading. Replaces the NarutoLoading background video instantly.$()

pages.title: Permission Commands
pages.text: Server operators (level 2) can control sync permissions:$(br2)$(bold)/dragit whitelist add <player>$()$(br)$(bold)/dragit whitelist remove <player>$()$(br)$(bold)/dragit blacklist add <player>$()$(br)$(bold)/dragit blacklist remove <player>$()$(br2)$(note)The blacklist overrides the global "All" toggle. The whitelist only applies when "All" is false.$()
